🚀✨ Copilot CLI v1.0.107 released!

637 features & enhancements in this release

Top features:
• Rex terminals render inline images using Kitty direct placements 🖼️
• Add /code command to open current session in VS Code
• /settings now opens unified dashboard with global search across settings and local resources 🔍
• Interactive CLI reports program status to supporting terminals, including attention alerts ⚠️
• Opt-in session management tools and mentions for local sessions
• Add GPT-6.1 Terra as a selectable model under new models when available to your account
• Add Fusion tier setting to copilot config
• Add Sandbox extensions setting to run extension processes inside sandbox
• Add COPILOT_SESSION_CWD to control launching and expanding LSP and local MCP server configs

Enhancements:
• MATS telemetry for Entra authentication through OneAuth respects client telemetry opt-out
• Model picker displays context window size for flat, unpriced, and single-tier models
• Sandboxed local MCP servers respect relative filesystem permissions from session directory
• PowerShell commands now work on Windows when CLI installed in long directory paths
• MCP Entra authentication falls back to VS Code registration when preauthorization is unavailable
• Sandboxed local MCP servers start correctly when configured with a relative cwd
• On Windows, sandboxed sessions in nested Git directories can change to and write at repository root
• Suppress unnecessary MCP reload summaries when plugin servers remain unchanged
• ACP clients can switch a session started with --yolo out of autopilot without policy errors
• @ file picker now correctly underlines names with capital dotted I and decomposed accents
• Up and Down keys in multiline prompts keep starting column when moving through shorter lines
• Ctrl+Y and /share research skip unreadable or invalid research folder entries
• Inline images removed or replaced in prompt no longer sent with messages; Ctrl+S can stash prompts afterwards
• Pasted text with NEL and Unicode separators fills separate prompt lines; dropped DEL and C1 control chars

Bug fixes:
• copilot -p --plan no longer suggests Shift+Tab to leave plan mode; includes key plan points instead
• copilot --resume no longer waits indefinitely when Copilot task service unresponsive; times out after 10s
• Sandboxed grep, rg, and glob report Windows launch failures instead of silent no-match results
• Switching sessions while others are busy no longer crashes CLI or leaves blank terminal
• Retrying prompts with corrupt images now keeps readable image attachments
• Autopilot no longer implements recommendations after requests only asking for review or analysis
• Model request receiving empty 404 under load is retried instead of ending turn with error
• On Windows, sandboxed session starts correctly with nested Git repos and relative directories
• Remove shortened rows and ensure correct underlining in @ file picker with Unicode decompositions
• Fix edge cases with autopilot switching and allow-all flag toggling
• Correct prompt paste behavior dropping invalid control characters to prevent line truncation

Misc:
• copilot help config now lists all settings from settings catalog, including previously missing ones
• Add MATS telemetry for authentication with client opt-out respected
• Improved docs and setup for session management and authentication flows
• Hardened telemetry and permission handling defaults for Sandbox and MCP servers
• Updated tooling to enhance terminal and editor integrations

Elevate classic men's fashion style with the perfect blend of linen and wool fabrics.👦

Prompt: Create an ultra realistic, high resolution luxury fashion editorial photograph with professional photography standards and physically accurate camera settings. Preserve the exact identity, facial structure, distinctive features, proportions, and natural skin tone of the person in the reference image without alteration.

A handsome 25 year old male model with a defined jawline, symmetrical facial features, smooth natural skin texture, expressive dark brown eyes, neatly styled dark wavy hair, and a calm, confident expression. He stands on a grand classical stone terrace with elegant balustrades, his body slightly angled towards the camera and both hands casually tucked into his trouser pockets.

He wears a tailored beige linen blazer over an ivory cable knit wool V neck sweater and a crisp white dress shirt with a structured collar, paired with a brown plaid silk tie. Dark tortoiseshell sunglasses are hooked neatly at the center of the sweater neckline, while a patterned pocket square subtly accents the blazer. Pleated cream white trousers and a dark brown woven leather belt complete the outfit.

The background features softly blurred historical European architecture. Warm afternoon sunlight creates natural shadows and delicate golden rim lighting across the subject.

Photographed on a professional full frame camera with an 85mm portrait lens at f/1.8, shallow depth of field, precise focus on the subject's face, realistic optical rendering, natural skin texture, accurate anatomy, authentic fabric details, sophisticated warm editorial color grading, and refined luxury magazine aesthetics. 8K ultra detailed image quality.

Maintain absolute facial identity and reference accuracy. Avoid facial alterations, artificial skin smoothing, distorted anatomy, unnatural proportions, incorrect hands, extra fingers, duplicated accessories, inconsistent clothing details, artificial lighting, excessive retouching, and all visible AI generation artifacts.

GPT Image 2.5

Prompt:
UNIVERSAL AI EDITORIAL STUDIO PHOTOSHOOT - 4:5

Using the uploaded photograph as the sole identity reference, create a premium, photorealistic, luxury studio fashion campaign.

First, analyse the person in the photograph, including their appearance, age, personality, clothing, and overall aesthetic. Automatically develop a creative concept that best suits them.

CREATIVE DIRECTION:

- Choose a distinctive, oversized, imaginative studio prop that complements the person, such as a giant plush teddy bear, miniature house, toy vehicle, oversized flower, animal sculpture, or another unexpected object.
- Automatically select a beautiful monochromatic colour palette, coordinating the background, outfit, footwear, and oversized prop.
- Style the person in fashionable, coordinated clothing that suits their age, appearance, and the chosen concept.
- Create a natural, confident editorial pose, interacting with or leaning against the oversized prop.
- Use a seamless coloured studio background, professional softbox lighting, subtle shadows, and carefully composed framing.

IDENTITY PRESERVATION:
Maintain the person's exact facial identity, facial features, skin tone, hairstyle, age, and natural proportions. Do not change their identity or create an unrelated person.

VISUAL QUALITY:
Ultra-photorealistic commercial fashion photography, premium children's fashion campaign aesthetic when appropriate, realistic fabric textures, detailed props, sophisticated colour grading, crisp focus, and professional studio production quality.

IMPORTANT: Make all creative decisions automatically based on the uploaded person. Every generation should have a unique, thoughtfully matched concept rather than repeating the same prop, colour, or composition.

FORMAT: 4:5 vertical portrait, high resolution, polished professional advertising photography. No text, logos, watermarks, or unnecessary elements.

Open-source is critical for robotics AI. It means a student, a researcher or a startup can build on years of progress and contribute something the whole community can use rather than concentrating everything in a few companies building a black-box robot. 

That’s why we’re building @huggingface into the platform for open-source robotics AI! Amazing to see the progress we've made in the six months and it's accelerating!

- Almost 100,000 public robotics datasets on https://t.co/QIPmkxCk57, up 48%
- Over 30,000 public robotics models, up 41%
- Microduck and Reachy mini, our open-source robots became the most popular robot of 2026 (probably ending the year with 50,000+ sold and 20,000+ shipped)
- We’re a founding partner of @RoboColosseum, evaluating robots across 140+ real-world scenes. Every run is published publicly on HF, including failures, so everyone can learn from what actually happens.

And @LeRobotHF got downloaded over 1M times and v0.7.0 just landed with new world action models, interactive robot control and remote GPU inference: https://t.co/Euoz11Ccc5!

Huge thanks to everyone making this happen 🤗🦾
